# istio_authorization_policy (Resource)

Manages an Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource. AuthorizationPolicies define access control policies (ALLOW, DENY, CUSTOM, AUDIT) for workloads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_authorization_policy" "allow_frontend" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "security.istio.io/v1"
    kind       = "AuthorizationPolicy"
    metadata = {
      name      = "allow-frontend"
      namespace = "default"
    }
    spec = {
      selector = {
        matchLabels = {
          app = "backend-api"
        }
      }
      action = "ALLOW"
      rules = [
        {
          from = [
            {
              source = {
                principals = [
                  "cluster.local/ns/default/sa/frontend"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
          to = [
            {
              operation = {
                methods = ["GET", "POST"]
                paths   = ["/api/*"]
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full AuthorizationPolicy manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `security.istio.io/v1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
